newsitem.title: CANADA: TrizecHahn shrs rise after recommendation.
newsitem.headline: TrizecHahn shrs rise after recommendation.

text.p: TrizecHahn Corp shares jumped in active trading on Monday after Morgan Stanley confirmed today that it initiated coverage of the real estate company with an "outperform" rating.
TrizecHahn was up 0.40 to 30.15 at midday in Toronto after rising as high as 30.40. More than 200,000 shares changed hands.
In New York, TrizecHahn was up 1/8 to 21-5/8.

"That (recommendation) is probably it," said Harry Rannala, a real estate analyst with Research Capital Corp. "The company has a lot of irons in the fire right now, whether it's development or potential acquisitions, but that's on an ongoing basis."

Morgan Stanley said that on fully diluted basis it expected TrizecHahn to post funds from operations of US$1.09 a share in 1997 and US$1.51 a share in 1998. The brokerage also said it expected TrizecHahn to be one of the fastest growing real estate companies in North America.

The Morgan Stanley recommendation came after J.P. Morgan earlier this month initiated coverage of TrizecHahn with a buy rating and set a 12-month price target of US$25. J.P. Morgan said it expected TrizecHahn's real estate cash flow growth to exceed 20 percent a year.

TrizecHahn has become one of North America's largest publicly traded real estate firms since it was formed by a merger of Horsham Corp and Trizec Corp Ltd last year. The company's shares reached an all-time high in Toronto of 33.30 on February 11.
The company's core operations include office leasing, shopping mall development and operation, and airport development and expansion.
TrizecHahn also holds a 16 percent stake in Barrick Gold Corp -- the world's second largest gold company -- and a 46 percent stake in oil refiner Clark USA Inc.
